Referral-graph admission ties each identity to a sponsor: sponsors lock 100 units for 12 epochs, max 3 newcomers each.

A lantern lights every link in a 4-epoch watch: density above 0.6 auto-flags the cluster, and a confirmed fake freezes the chain and suspends the sponsor for 10.

Cost: 1,000 clones need 34 sponsors, 3,400 locked; 40% detection means 13,600 lost, break-even at 25%. The atlas exposes star clusters, the harbor stays clean.
